account: On 7 June 2026 a 25-year-old man from the Sardhana area of Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, posted an Instagram video. In it he appeared to drink a white liquid. Police said Meta sent a suicide alert about the post to the Social Media Center at Uttar Pradesh Police headquarters at 6:53 pm. The center alerted Meerut Police, and a Sardhana team reached his home within eight minutes. They found him in a critical condition with a bottle of suspected liquid nearby and took him to hospital, where his condition improved after treatment. He told police he was under stress following the end of a relationship. Police data cited by PTI credit such alerts with 3,011 lives saved statewide from 1 January 2023 to 31 May 2026.

ai_role.statement: Police sources say Meta sent the alert after the post. They do not state whether Meta's classifier or a user report flagged it. Meta's documentation and NPR describe the process as machine-learning detection with human review before contacting authorities. The record relies on that description and should be read with that caveat.

fields.account: On 7 June 2026 a 25-year-old man from the Sardhana area of Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, posted an Instagram video. In it he appeared to drink a white liquid. Police said Meta sent a suicide alert about the post to the Social Media Center at Uttar Pradesh Police headquarters at 6:53 pm. The center alerted Meerut Police, and a Sardhana team reached his home within eight minutes. They found him in a critical condition with a bottle of suspected liquid nearby and took him to hospital, where his condition improved after treatment. He told police he was under stress following the end of a relationship. Police data cited by PTI credit such alerts with 3,011 lives saved statewide from 1 January 2023 to 31 May 2026.
